'''Domestique''' (GEMP handle '''Domestique''') is a ''Star Wars'' CCG player from Cleveland.<ref name="ss26" /> He organized the [[2025 Scavenger Superbowl Showcase]] and the [[2026 Scrapyard Scrum]].<ref name="ssb" /><ref name="ss26" /> He finished 8th in both events.<ref name="ssb" /><ref name="ss26" />
